title: Almost finitary birepresentation theory and applications to affine Soergel bimodules
summary: In this article, we develop a generalization of finitary birepresentation theory applicable to Soergel bimodules for infinite Coxeter groups. We establish a reduction process for the classification of simple birepresentations of almost finitary bicategories, and consider in detail the case of Soergel bimodules in extended affine type A.
